nom: RODAN + FIELDS Multi-Acid Enzyme Peel Dark Spot Corrector + Exfoliator

Every product I have used from Rodman and Fields has been outstanding!!

My first purchase and love this product how it makes my skin feel renew and cleanly rejuvenated after usage.
Love the combination with the scrub. My face feels so fresh and clean and it glows!
I cannot say that I have seen much if any improvement on my facial skin. As I have aged, what used to be my skin type (T), I am seeing that my forehead has changed to more of the dry type.

I had tried a similar product and saw results in first time I tried I ordered same product but the difference was the color of the one I tried was like a brownish color and the one I received is white I haven't seen the same results.
I like to use this peel about once/week. It gives a nice tingle to my face so I know it's doing it's job. A nice addition to my weekly routine.
Makes me think I'm doing something good for my skin. definitely feels good after having applied it.

I am a prior esthetician and former RF consultant years ago. I have always loved the products and known the remarkable results as this is what brought me back. I was shocked to see an enzyme peel being sent without warnings and detailed instructions. I've now used it myself a few times and seen no effects.
My complexion looks more refreshed and glowing, making this an easy favorite in my skincare routine. It gently exfoliates without irritation.

I just started using this product so I cannot give it 5 stars as of yet, however, I do like the way my skin feels after application. I cannot wait to see the results after a few more weeks. I had had no reaction to my skin
This is a gentle but effective product. I apply it under moisturizer in the morning to help even my skin tone it's helpful eith dark spots too.
My skin has never looked better, love the light, gentle peel that keeps fresh glowing skin underneath!
Works great! Fantastic product (s) all that I have used have visibly shown signs of improvement
My skin feels so soft and new after the Multi-Acid Enzyme Peel. It helps the other steps of my regimen work more effectively!

I have not noticed any change since I started. 3 times a week.
I feel when I use it longer than I have. I can give a truer rating .
I love this product. My skin feels so smooth and glowy using it
Wonderful product. My skin feels smoother, cleaner and much more clear. Would definitely recommend the Multi-Acid peel to everyone. A JOYful customer!

I really think it is helping my 75 year old skin. My skin seems brighter and looks better to me. My clay soap dried my skin so I am very glad to have the new soap.
I wear it three times a day , just in 2 weeks and I can see my face and my neck is getting so soft and smooth. Love it .
I love this product; I need more than just exfoliation. Using this product keeps everything in check. Thank you R+F!!!

This product has truly kept my skin soft, smooth and glowing. When I first started using R & D, 15 years ago, my daughter in-law complimented me on my skin. That is all that it took. I will continue to use this product well into my 80's. Thank you.
I love this product more than I thought I would. It leaves my skin smooth and glowy.

I love your products have been using them for 5 years. Had to take a break and looked in the mirror and called immediately and restocked my products.

This is one of my favorite Rodan and Fields product and one that I never want to be without.
Seems like a quality product but hard to say this early about results. Certainly I have been using Rodan and Fields for 15+ years now and my skin does look younger than most.

It seems to be helping with the shine makes the skin on my face look amazing.
Love it and use it 3-4 times a week. It has help my skin feel like I'm getting a peel with no down time. My skin feels great!
I have only used this product once so far, but my experience was an oar with all of my R + F fabulousness so far!

I can tell a difference in my skin. It is absolutely smoother.
